description: Active voucher of the store, started, not expired, with balance left, restricted to one customer account (only that customer may use it; checkout auto-applies it to them). Applied/removed, no order placed. KB: Managing Vouchers; Configuring a Voucher.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode); a voucher belongs to one store

now.description: System param: evaluation time, filled in by the profiler or resolver; tests do not set it

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId the voucher must be restricted to; link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId). Left out: any customer

notOwner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId the voucher must NOT be restricted to (a different customer's voucher): link it to @user.userId. Left out: no exclusion
